findings.title: Configured regression command exits non-zero (fails the quality gate)
findings.evidence: regression_results[0]: `uv --directory backend run pytest -m "not e2e"` returns exit_code 1. stdout shows `116 passed, 14 skipped` but stderr shows pytest `_ensure_unconfigure` raising `ExceptionGroup: multiple unraisable exception warnings` -> `PytestUnraisableExceptionWarning: Exception ignored in: <socket.socket fd=12 ...>` / `fd=11` (`ResourceWarning: unclosed <socket.socket ...>`). `pytest.ini` line 8-9 sets `filterwarnings = error`, so the GC-time ResourceWarning from leaked clients is escalated to a fatal error and the process exits 1. `.specify/config/review.yml` line 18 sets `fail_on.failed_regression: true`, so this evidence forces the gate to FAIL closed.
findings.recommendation: Fix the socket leak (see next finding) so the suite exits 0, or scope `filterwarnings` to not escalate `PytestUnraisableExceptionWarning`/`ResourceWarning` at teardown. Do not accept the gate as green while the sole configured regression command returns exit 1; the 116-passed summary and the exit code are inconsistent and must be reconciled before this evidence can support a PASS.

findings.title: API tests instantiate TestClient without closing it, leaking sockets
findings.evidence: `TestClient(app).get(...)` is created inline and discarded, never `.close()`d nor used as `with TestClient(app) as client:`. Same pattern in test_catalogo_categorie_api.py:42,61,73, test_catalogo_tipologia_sol.py:23, test_catalogo_tipi_documento_api.py:21, test_campi_richiesti_api.py:52,76, common/test_api_error_response.py:11,24, common/test_security_jwt.py:98, and validation/test_validazione_payload_api.py:25 (fixture `yield TestClient(app)` also never closes). Starlette's TestClient wraps an httpx.Client plus an anyio portal; not closing it leaks the transport and the event-loop AF_UNIX socketpair seen in the regression stderr (family=1 sockets), which under `filterwarnings=error` breaks the suite exit status.
findings.recommendation: Introduce a shared fixture `with TestClient(app) as client: yield client` (or context-manage each call site) so transports/portals are closed deterministically; this removes the ResourceWarning and stabilizes the regression command's exit code.

findings.title: Committed agent hooks hardcode /opt/homebrew/bin/tokensave, breaking non-Homebrew/CI environments
findings.evidence: New untracked files that would be committed (no `.gitignore` entry for `.claude/`, `.codex/`, `.mcp.json`): `.claude/settings.json` lines 16, 29, 43 and `.mcp.json` line 12 invoke `/opt/homebrew/bin/tokensave` (Homebrew Apple-Silicon path). On Linux, Intel macOS (`/usr/local/bin`), or any machine without tokensave, the UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse/Stop hooks and the tokensave MCP server fail to spawn. `.mcp.json` uses a bare `codegraph` command but not for tokensave. Constitution VI requires the repo be reusable by other administrations without local machine state.
findings.recommendation: Invoke `tokensave` by bare name via PATH (as done for `codegraph`), make the hooks tolerate a missing binary, and/or gitignore machine-local agent settings so only portable config is version-controlled.

findings.title: Non-optional after_implement hook runs `adev review` with no availability check or fallback
findings.evidence: `.specify/extensions.yml` and `.specify/extensions/adev-quality/extension.yml` register the `after_implement` hook `speckit.adev-quality.review` with `optional: false` / `enabled: true`. The skill (.agents/skills/speckit-adev-quality-review/SKILL.md:20-24) and command (.specify/extensions/adev-quality/commands/speckit.adev-quality.review.md:15-17) only run `adev review`. `.specify/config/tools.yml` enumerates codegraph/tokensave/rtk/headroom/caveman but never `adev` itself, so there is no deterministic install check for the binary the blocking hook depends on. Any contributor running `implement` without `adev` on PATH hits a non-optional hook failure.
findings.recommendation: Add an `adev` entry (install_check: command_available) to tools.yml, document it as a required dev dependency in the standard docs, or set the hook `optional: true` until the toolchain is guaranteed in every environment that runs the workflow.

findings.title: Feature-completion gate hard-depends on external codex and claude CLIs and specific model ids
findings.evidence: review.yml lines 4-13 and 39-49 pin `developer.provider: codex_cli` model `gpt-5`, reviewer `provider: claude_code` model `sonnet`, requiring `command: codex` and `command: claude` on PATH with `timeout_seconds: 900`. With `fail_on.malformed_report: true` and `security_review: true`, a missing provider CLI produces a malformed report and a hard FAIL, coupling 'feature complete' to two external CLIs and named models that are not checked anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Document the required reviewer/developer CLIs and models in the standard config or tools.yml, and/or allow a degraded static-only review mode so the gate fails with a clear 'provider missing' signal instead of 'malformed report'.

findings.title: Review run artifacts under .adev/ are not gitignored; absolute paths and duplicated constitution would be committed
findings.evidence: .gitignore has no `.adev/` entry. `.adev/reviews/run-20260901T133503Z/sessions/primary/request.json` embeds the absolute developer path `/Users/danieleramacci/Desktop/CNR/geban/builder-modello-bando`, a full copy of `.specify/memory/constitution.md`, and captured pytest stdout/stderr. `git add -A` would version per-run review state (churn + local-path leakage). `.specify/extensions/.registry` also has no trailing newline.
findings.recommendation: Add `.adev/reviews/` (or `.adev/`) to `.gitignore`, keep only durable standard config under version control, and add the trailing newline to `.specify/extensions/.registry`.
